samples.xml_description:
<module id="fixed_point_subtractor">
	<description>A fixed-point subtractor for precise arithmetic operations with fixed precision.</description>
	
	<ports>
		<input id="a" width_description="[N-1:0]">First N-bit fixed-point input operand.</input>
		<input id="b" width_description="[N-1:0]">Second N-bit fixed-point input operand.</input>
		
		<output id="c" width_description="[N-1:0]">N-bit output representing the result of the fixed-point subtraction.</output>
	endports
	
	<parameter_description>
		<N> Total number of bits used for inputs and outputs (integer + fractional).</N>
		<Q> Number of fractional bits in the fixed-point representation.</Q>
	endparameter_description
	
	<logic_description type="sequential_logic">
		reg signed[N-1:0] res;
		wire signed[N-1:0] temp_a = $signed(a);
		wire signed[N-1:0] temp_b = $signed(b);
		assign c = res;
	endlogic_description
	
	<implementation>
		integer i;
		always@(*) begin
			
			if(temp_a[N-1]==temp_b[N-1]) begin //Same sign
				res <= (a[N-2:0]-b[N-2:0]);
				res[N-1] <= a[N-1];
				
			end else if((~(a[N-1]^b[N-1]))==1 && ($signed(a)>=0))begin//Positive
				res <= $unsigned(a+b);
				res[N-1] <= a[N-1];
				
			end else if ((~(a[N-1]^b[N-1]))==1 && ($signed(a)<$signed(b)))begin//Negative
				for(i=0;i<N-1;i=i+1)begin
					res[i] <= ~(a[i]|b[i]); 
				end
				
				res[N-1]<= 0;
			
			end else if((~(a[N-1]^b[N-1]))==1 && ($signed(a)>$signed(b)))begin //Positive
				res <= (a-b);
				res[N-1] <= 1;
				
			end else begin //Zero
				res<=0;
				res[N-1]</implementation></logic_description></parameter_description></ports></module>
